verdict.rationale: Ironclad can be driven without its UI through a REST API. Machine-to-machine OAuth Client Credentials auth suits unattended jobs, and documented endpoints cover launching and bulk-launching workflows, records, data exports and webhook management. However, there is no CLI or CI-specific tooling, the API requires a paid add-on, and some setup (publishing workflows in Workflow Designer) stays in the UI. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration/examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), API access without an add-on, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), fully headless setup of workflows/templates, independent hands-on corroboration of automation use.
